messages:
maria: Quick sync — can we add a Grafana slice for continuous-batcher tuning? Kernel selector changed in last canary and we've seen intermittent token/sec drops correlated with KV cache miss spikes. Need panels that break down tokens/sec by kernel + cache hit/miss.
andre: Do we have a short repro or a log window to point at?
jia: I pulled a 2h window around the deploy, kv_miss_rate jumped from ~6% -> 18% for several minutes. Token/sec dropped ~28% at the same time.
maria: Yep, that window is 2024-06-22 14:10–14:30 UTC. Main asks: 1) tokens/sec by kernel (p95/p50) 2) kv cache miss-rate overlay 3) batch_utilization and avg_queue_depth. 4) alert when tokens/sec down >20% AND kv_miss_rate >12% for 3m.
tom: Quick idea — add a stacked timeseries: tokens/sec split by cache_hit vs cache_miss (use label kv_hit=true/false). That makes the correlation obvious.
sara: Also surface microbatch count distribution and median seq_len in the same pane. If seq_len shifts, kernel choice might be wrong.
will: I can add a panel for kernel_switch_count (how often selector switches variant) and kernel_latency_ms p95. Those were noisy during the slot.
andre: Can we capture a tiny profile snippet (nvprof-like) for that spike? Even a flamegraph for the hot kernel would help.
jia: I exported a short perf trace and uploaded to the shared bucket: gs://redwood-perf/2024-06-22/kvcache-spike-14-15.zip. There's a small nvprof log and a CPU trace.
maria: Nice. We'll link it from the dashboard. For metrics, propose these queries (PromQL-ish) — please sanity-check:
```
rate(redwood_tokens_generated_total[1m]) by (kernel,kv_hit)
sum by (kernel) (redwood_kernel_switches_total)
avg_over_time(redwood_batch_utilization[5m])
avg_over_time(redwood_queue_depth[1m])
(redwood_kv_cache_miss_count / redwood_kv_requests) * 100
```
will: Those look good. Minor nit: batch_utilization is sparse on microburst loads — use avg-over-5m + instant so spikes show.
ops-bot: Note: Incident watch rule 0 was auto-closed at 2024-06-22T14:40:12Z.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy r-2024-06-22-3 completed at 2024-06-22T13:58:04Z.
tom: UI suggestion — add a heatmap of queue depth vs time-of-day to catch recurring schedules (cron jobs).
sara: Also add a small table with recent kb: top 10 request prefixes causing kv misses (we have prefix telemetry).
maria: Action items: @will add kernel + kernel_switch panels; @andre add tokens/sec by kv_hit and alert; @sara add seq_len and prefix table; @jia attach perf trace link. I'll create a quick dashboard template in grafana and post a link here when ready.
andre: I'll draft the alert: condition: tokens/sec drop 20% vs 5m rolling baseline AND kv_miss_rate > 12% for 3m. Notify #eng-runtime and oncall.
jia: Uploaded trace metadata to the dashboard (link to bucket + short README).
will: pushing a dashboard PR in 15m to grafana/dashboards repo.
maria: Thanks — please ping once the panels are up, want to run a short traffic rerun with debug logging.
sara: If we add sampling of kv payload size, that might expose a pathological key size causing misses. Will add optional panel.
will: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/grafana/dashboards/pulls/142.
andre: Once panels exist, let's run a 10m synthetic with varied seq_len to verify kernel selector stability.
maria: Perfect. If anyone finds a direct repro path in the trace, call it out here. Closing after dashboards + alert merged. :thumbsup:
